# FinCalcHub

> FinCalcHub is a free, privacy-conscious, browser-based platform providing online financial, business, marketing, investment, tax, cryptocurrency, and general-purpose calculators. Most calculations are performed locally in the user's browser without requiring an account.

## Main Pages

- [FinCalcHub](https://www.fincalchub.xyz/) — Homepage and primary calculator suite.
- [Tools](https://www.fincalchub.xyz/tools.html) — Browse the available calculators and tools.
- [About](https://www.fincalchub.xyz/about.html) — Information about FinCalcHub.
- [Blog](https://www.fincalchub.xyz/blog.html) — Financial guides, calculator explanations, and educational articles.
- [FAQ](https://www.fincalchub.xyz/faq.html) — Frequently asked questions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.fincalchub.xyz/privacy.html) — Privacy and data-use information.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.fincalchub.xyz/terms.html) — Terms governing use of the website.

## Calculator Suite

FinCalcHub provides calculators covering the following areas:

- Cryptocurrency conversion and market-price calculations.
- Marketing ROAS and ROI calculations.
- Freelance invoice and hourly-rate calculations.
- A/B testing calculations.
- Compound-interest calculations.
- SIP investment calculations.
- Income-tax calculations.
- Savings-goal calculations.
- Retirement-planning calculations.
- Business profit-margin calculations.
- SaaS CAC and LTV calculations.
- E-commerce net-profit calculations.
- Installment calculations.
- Average-price calculations.
- Simple Calculator.
- Scientific Calculator.

## Data Sources

- [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/) — Live cryptocurrency market data where used by the cryptocurrency calculator.
- [ExchangeRate-API](https://www.exchangerate-api.com/) — Live exchange-rate data where used by applicable currency calculations.

Live data may require an internet connection. Cached or offline calculator functionality should not be interpreted as providing live market information.

## Intended Users

FinCalcHub is designed for:

- Students and learners.
- Individuals managing personal calculations.
- Freelancers.
- Digital marketers.
- Business owners.
- SaaS companies.
- Investors.
- E-commerce sellers.

## Usage and Accuracy

FinCalcHub provides calculators and educational information for general informational purposes. Calculator results are estimates based on the inputs and assumptions provided by the user and should not be considered financial, investment, tax, accounting, legal, or other professional advice.

Users should verify important financial decisions and calculations with appropriate authoritative or professional sources.
